usageNotes: Use this before attempting a snapshot, clone, or copy operation on an LXC container to confirm the underlying storage driver supports it — not all storage types (e.g. NFS, ZFS without snapshots enabled) support every feature. Pass `snapname` when checking feature availability against a specific existing snapshot rather than the running container. Returns a single boolean `hasFeature`; gate any dependent operation on a `true` result.

examples.summary: Check whether LXC 110 on node pve1 supports cloning

tips: Feature support is determined by the storage backend of the container's root disk, not the container config itself — a container on local-lvm may behave differently than one on a directory-backed storage.
Use `snapname` to verify that a specific snapshot can still be cloned or copied after the container config has changed.
This endpoint is read-only and lightweight; safe to call in pre-flight checks before any clone/snapshot/copy workflow.
